title: MetricBoard
guideIntro: You're testing an analytics dashboard. Check the overview charts, the report table, and the export page.

bugs.title: Chart label text truncated
bugs.description: The 'Revenue by Quarter' label is clipped by its container's overflow:hidden, making it read as 'Revenue by Q'.
bugs.remediation: Widen the label container or use text-overflow: ellipsis with a title attribute.
bugs.guideHint: Read every label fully — is any text cut off?

bugs.title: Chart image missing alt text
bugs.description: The revenue chart is rendered as an with no alt attribute. Screen reader users have no idea what data it shows.
bugs.remediation: Add alt text summarizing the chart data: alt="Revenue chart: Q1 $42K, Q2 $58K, Q3 $71K, Q4 $65K".
bugs.guideHint: Look for images that a screen reader can't describe

bugs.title: Filter dropdown is disabled
bugs.description: The region filter select element has a disabled attribute, preventing users from filtering the report data.
bugs.remediation: Remove the disabled attribute and implement the onChange handler.
bugs.guideHint: Try every dropdown and button — do they all respond?

bugs.title: Data table missing header cells
bugs.description: The report table uses <td> for all cells, including the header row. Screen readers cannot associate data cells with their column headers.
bugs.remediation: Change the first row's <td> elements to <th scope="col"> elements.
bugs.guideHint: Inspect the data table — can a screen reader navigate it?

bugs.title: Stale 'last updated' date
bugs.description: The report header shows 'Last updated: Jan 2024' despite the data covering Q3 2025. The timestamp hasn't been refreshed.
bugs.remediation: Update the date to reflect the actual data range.
bugs.guideHint: Check the dates — do they match the data shown?

bugs.title: Export CSV button is disabled
bugs.description: The 'Export as CSV' button has a disabled attribute with no explanation, preventing users from downloading their data.
bugs.remediation: Remove the disabled attribute and implement the download handler.
bugs.guideHint: Try clicking every button — do they all work?

bugs.title: Export preview image missing alt
bugs.description: The chart preview thumbnail has no alt attribute. Screen readers skip it entirely.
bugs.remediation: Add alt="Preview of the exported chart showing revenue trends".
bugs.guideHint: Look for images that a screen reader can't describe
